preconditions.description: The input string s contains at least one character.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'MF' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string s consists only of characters 'M' (boy) and 'F' (girl).

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == max((i - j) for i, j in enumerate([(k, v) for k, v in enumerate(s) if v == 'F'], 0) for k, v in enumerate([(k, v) for k, v in enumerate(s) if v == 'F'], 0) if i > j) if any(c == 'F' for c in s) and any(c == 'M' for c in s) else 0
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of seconds required for any girl to pass all boys initially preceding her, calculated as the maximum difference between a girl's initial index and the count of boys before her; if the line contains only boys or only girls, the output is 0.
